name: Sarah M.
text: Kurt was fantastic! He arrived on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and had our burst pipe fixed within the hour. Highly recommend KA Plumbing.

name: James T.
text: We use KA Plumbing for all our rental properties. Kurt is reliable, professional, and always communicates clearly. Best plumber in Auckland.

text: Kurt handled our entire centre's plumbing upgrade with minimal disruption. His attention to safety and compliance was impressive.

text: Complete bathroom renovation done beautifully. Kurt's workmanship is top quality and he kept us informed every step of the way.

text: Emergency call-out on a Saturday night — Kurt was there within 30 minutes. Saved us from flooding. Absolute legend.
